mapper.select:
/* master.mpif.selectMasterMpIfCowayBillList */
SELECT DISTINCT B.BUYER, BG.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME, B.PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ, C.PR_NO, C.PR_SEQ, A.LEGACY_GR_NO, D.USER_NAME_LOC AS REQ_USER_NAME, (SELECT E.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 E WHERE 1 = 1 AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = D.COM_CODE AND E.CODE = D.DEPARTMENT AND E.FLAG = 'Y' ) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, AG.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT LTEXT FROM COWAY_BUDGET_ORG_ET_TREE WHERE BGORG = C.BUDGET_DEPT AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BUDGET_DEPT, (SELECT LTEXT FROM COWAY_ACCOUNT_ET_OUTPUT WHERE BGACT = C.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, B.ADD_DATE, B.RD_DATE, A.GR_DATE, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.ITEM_AMT, (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA BA WHERE 1 = 1 AND BI.BUYER = BA.COM_CODE AND BI.CATEGORY_NO = BA.STD_CATEG_ID ) AS CATEGORY_PATH, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, REPLACE(REPLACE(B.DESCRIPTION,CHR(10),''),CHR(13),'') AS DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.UNIT_MEASURE, BI.MAKER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = NVL(BI.ORIGIN_CODE,'Z1') ) AS ORIGIN_CODE FROM ICOMGRDT A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPRDT C , ICOMPOHD PH , ICOMCMPY AG , ICOMCMPY BG , ICOMBYIT BI , ICOMLUSR D , ICOMLUSR F WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001','KRCOWA0005','KRCOWA0006')
AND A.GR_DATE LIKE #{YYYYMM}||'%'
AND TRIM(A.LEGACY_GR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R')
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R')
AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PR_NO = B.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ = B.PR_SEQ AND C.STATUS IN ('C','R')
AND B.BUYER = PH.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = PH.PO_NO
AND PH.AGENT = AG.COM_CODE
AND PH.BUYER = BG.COM_CODE
AND BG.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = BI.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BI.BUYER_ITEM_NO
AND D.USER_ID = C.PURCHASER_ID
AND F.USER_ID = C.REQ_USER_ID
ORDER BY B.BUYER, B.PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ, A.GR_DATE
